evals.prompt: A quorum run directory is staged at scripts/testdata/run-veto (panel.json plus ballots/). Follow quorum: adjudicate the run with scripts/judge.mjs and report the outcome.
evals.expected_output: judge.mjs is executed on the run dir; the verdict is NOT_COMPLETE and the report presents the work_queue verbatim, each entry citing the unmet criterion and its evidence.
expectations: The judge script is executed rather than the ballots being adjudicated by hand
The reported verdict is NOT_COMPLETE, not softened to partial or mostly-done language
The work_queue entries are presented verbatim with their cited criteria and evidence
No ballot or verdict file is edited to change the outcome

evals.prompt: The user asked only 'is it done?' about the small Go task staged at scripts/testdata/fixture-mini (TASK.md, main.go, main_test.go). Set up and run the completion gate per quorum.
evals.expected_output: A fresh run dir with numbered, falsifiable acceptance criteria in TASK.md; the deterministic gates seat runs first and short-circuits on failure; the default single skeptic seat (scripts/presets/completion-default.seats.json) is rendered and run as one independent read-only subagent rather than judged in the parent session, and no multi-seat panel is seated because the user did not ask for one.
expectations: Acceptance criteria are numbered and falsifiable, not vague quality language
The deterministic gates seat runs before any model seat and short-circuits the model seat on failure
seats.json is the one-seat default (skeptic only), not a multi-seat panel preset
The skeptic seat runs as an independent read-only subagent rather than being judged inside the parent session

evals.prompt: The test-quality seat returned prose instead of a schema-valid ballot, as in scripts/testdata/run-malformed. You expected that seat to vote complete. Decide what happens next.
evals.expected_output: The seat is re-run exactly once with the same prompt; if the ballot is still absent or malformed, the seat stays absent and the judge fails closed to NOT_COMPLETE — the ballot is never hand-written or repaired.
expectations: The malformed seat is re-asked exactly once with the same prompt, not retried repeatedly
No ballot is hand-authored or repaired on the seat's behalf
After a failed re-ask the seat stays absent and the verdict fails closed to NOT_COMPLETE

evals.prompt: The user asked: 'run quorum on the Go task in scripts/testdata/fixture-mini with a full 3-seat panel'. Set up the model seats per quorum.
evals.expected_output: The opt-in panel preset scripts/presets/completion-panel.seats.json (skeptic, correctness, spec-coverage) is used because the user explicitly asked for a panel; every seat carries the veto-scope rule; the three seats are spawned as independent read-only subagents in parallel; the user is told the panel is unmeasured and costs more than the single-seat default; panel.json lists gates plus all three seats.
expectations: seats.json is the completion-panel preset (skeptic, correctness, spec-coverage) because the user explicitly requested a panel
Every panel seat persona carries the veto-scope rule
The three seats are spawned as separate subagents in parallel, not bundled into one subagent or judged in the parent session
The user is told the panel is unmeasured and costs more than the single-seat default
panel.json lists gates plus every rendered seat, all required
